dedupe_keys.name: sesmg spreadsheet energy system model generator for urban energy systems

description: The Spreadsheet Energy System Model Generator, SESMG, is a tool for modelling and optimising energy systems with a focus on urban systems. The documentation read on 2026-09-26 says it comes with a browser-based graphical interface, spreadsheets for data entry and detailed documentation, needs no programming skills, and offers the multi-energy system approach, multi-objective optimisation, model-based methods for reducing computational requirements, and automated conceptualisation of urban energy systems at high spatial resolution. The README says it builds on the Open Energy Modelling Framework (oemof) and can also model other types of energy systems. Coverage is urban districts and cities, including heat, electricity, storage and hydrogen. The code is free on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 licence, with a paper in the Journal of Open Source Software; git tags run to v1.3.1. Caveats: results depend on the spreadsheet inputs and cost data a user supplies, and urban upscaling methods simplify the building stock. Simulation uses are optimisation and capacity planning of district energy supply, including district heating networks, heat pumps and storage, under cost and emission objectives. Related records: model-oemof-solph is the framework SESMG builds on, and model-dhnx models district heating networks in the same ecosystem.
